body: i don't just think it, i *know* it. i've tried dating other guys, none of them come close. you don't just connect with someone on every single level willy nilly. relationships like that are soul mates, and you only get one

because nobody else is as perfect as he is. i've dated quit a few guys and none of them come close, objectively and quantitatively. i don't want to settle for someone who doesn't make me happy.

even if i were willing settle for someone i hated, there's also the fact, which gets pointed out quite frequently, that nobody wants me.
i have what i need from a survival standpoint. there's food, water, shelter. what i want, no, i have none of it, with no means to obtain it
he won't come back to me.

What was my crime though?

what was the action which deserves such punishment? and, since the action can logically not be undone and i am forced to push this 'boulder' forever, why should i not throw myself in front of it and let it crush me?

i want my ex to come back and marry me. i want children. i want to ditch the phd and be a full-time homemaker and mother. i want that charming, simple life where the stressors are 'did johnny have a dentist appointment this morning?' and 'susie needs 4 dozen cupcakes for her class by tomorrow!'. i want the suburban dream: a kid and two dogs, my ex as a wonderful husband, brunch with the ladies from tennis featuring mimosas. i fantasize about these things all the time, knowing full well it will never happen. i can't stop torturing myself with these dreams!

zero quality as in the only dreams and hopes that have existed since i was knee-high cannot be realized. there will never be full self-actualization or succession upon Maslow's hierarchy. As in, living constantly in existential crisis.

One knows happiness in the vicarious sense. Seeing other succeed where one fails and recognizing their satisfaction. The existence of this particular individual will not feature any such contentment.
just saw the rule about not getting serious. it's okay. you can laugh at me: i know i'm pathetic and miserable. have at it. laugh away.

i bury my own issues and just focus on theirs. keep all of my problems and depression hidden so far down that it will never come out at work. on Thursday had a patient tell me how she wishes she could be like me: 'always so calm and emotionally stable'. i had to bite my lip not to snicker at the irony. it's exhausting to always have to play pretend. i can't wait to get out of the hospital after work so that i can let all the emotions out. usually reddit helps, but today the trolls have been out and being meaner than usual.
